original.target_description: Experiment 1 overall within-subject comparison of decision-quality ratings for matched successful versus failed outcomes, across seven matched case pairs; p. 572 (fourth article page), Results.

n.sample_role: Undergraduate participants in the Experiment 1 overall within-subject outcome-bias test; repeated case ratings are not independent participants.
n.exclusions: No Experiment 1 participant exclusions or missing target ratings reported. The later seven-subject normative-belief subgroup is a separate analysis.
n.location: p. 572 (fourth article page), Experiment 1, Subjects and Results
n.quote: Subjects were 20 undergraduates at the University of Penn- ... sylvania, obtained through a sign placed on a prominent campus walk- ... way and paid by the hour. Ten subjects did the cases in the order given; ... 10 did them in reverse order. ... Overall, there was an outcome bias. ... Cases in which the outcome was success (Cases 1, 3, 5, 7, 10, ... 12, and 14) were rated higher than matched cases in which the ... outcome was failure (Cases 2, 4, 6, 8, 11, 13, and 15): mean ... effect = 0.70, r(19) = 4.04, p < .001, one-tailed.
